---
name: sir-document
description: Produce a concise SIREngine architecture decision, implementation note, issue handoff or engineering receipt grounded in current source.
argument-hint: '[document type and subject]'
---
# Technical documentation

1. Inspect current source and relevant `Docs/Architecture`, `Docs/Decisions` and tests.
2. Separate implemented behavior, approved design, work-in-progress and open questions.
3. Cite source paths/SHA, describe inputs/outputs, ownership, versioning, constraints and reproducible commands.
4. Write only authorized documentation paths. Do not retroactively claim implementation or test completion.
